svg.title: GitHub contribution snake
svg.desc: A cyan and teal snake travels through the real GitHub contribution calendar from 2026-07-09 to 2026-10-28. The calendar contains 112 days and 699 contributions. The snake starts with 7 segments and grows by one for each active day eaten, reaching 118 segments. Empty days do not add length. It fades out before resetting each loop. Source as of 2026-10-28T02:39:36.073000+00:00. Reduced-motion mode shows the complete static calendar.

g.text: Each active square makes the snake longer.
